services.desc: Step aboard our 24’ center console and discover the best of Key West’s stunning waters! Perfect for groups of up to six people, this private, captain-guided adventure takes you through crystal-clear waters to beautiful sandbars and unspoiled beaches that can only be reached by boat. With comfortable seating and a T-top for shade, you’ll have everything you need for a fun and relaxing day exploring the breathtaking beauty of the Florida Keys! Your Day, Your Way: Decide on the exact itinerary the day of your trip! services.name: St. Patrick's Day Happy Hour Sail
services.desc: Celebrate St. Patrick's Day on the water with Danger Charters! Join us for an intimate and fun-filled voyage, surrounded by the shimmering blue, sometimes a little green, waters of Key West. Don your greenest attire and set sail for a 1.5-hour journey around the enchanting island of Key West. Indulge in the spirit of the Irish with a selection of light snacks and refreshments, both spirited and non-alcoholic. It's a St. Patrick's Day celebration on the high seas that you won't want to miss!
